    • zReport

      ResultSet zReport() throws SQLException
      Z-Report (end-of-day). Includes an hourly breakdown and a final total row with hour=999. After generating the report, archives today's orders by shifting their timestamps to yesterday, effectively resetting the X-Report counts for the next business day.

      This implements the traditional cash register behavior where Z-Report is run once at end-of-day and resets the daily totals.

      Throws:
      SQLException
